translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: « ‹Itti Asay ittippetetsaa yarshshoo bare wudiyaappe mac'c'awaa gidina attumawaa gidina itti mehiyaa shiishshiyaa wode, he mehii tilla bollaanna de'iyaawaa Med'inaa Godaa sintsan shiishsho.

Yarshshanaw aheedda mehiyaa huup'iyaan bare kushiyaa wotsiide, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa penggiyaan shukko. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, k'eesatuu Aaroona naanay suutsaa yarshshiyaa sa'aa miyyiyaa ubbaa bollan gusso.
Ittippetetsaa yarshshuwaappe taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide Med'inaa Godaw shiishsho; hewekka k'antsaa ashuwaa mayyeedda handdaa ubbaynne aanana gatsiyaa handday,
laa"u kilahotuwaa, unttunttu bolla de'iyaa handdaa, gaylliyaa matan de'iyaa handdaanne tiriyaa s'eeraa bolla de'iyaa handdaa kilahotuwaana gatsiide akkee.

Aaroona attuma naanay hewaa hara s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanna yarshshiyaa sa'aa bolla de'iyaa mitsaa bolla wotsiide s'uuggino; hewe Med'inaa Godaw taman s'uuggiyaa, sawuwaa toshukku giyaa yarshshuwaa gidanawaa.
« ‹Med'inaa Godaw ittippetetsaa yarshshuwaa shiishshiyaa uray dorssaa gidina deeshshaa, mac'c'awaa gidina attumawaa tilla bollaanna de'iyaawaa shiishsho.
Itti uray dorssaa maraa yarshshiyaawaa gidooppe, Med'inaa Godaa sintsan shiishsho;
bare kushiyaa Aa huup'iyaan wotsiide, Dunkkaaniyaa sintsan shukko. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Aaroona attuma naanay suutsaa oyk'k'iide, yarshshiyaa sa'aa miyyiyaa ubbaa bollan gussino.

Ittippetetsaa yarshshuwaappe taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaw shiishsho; hewekka, ziizziyaappe k'ans's'eedda nasiyaa, ulo giddo ashuwaa mayyeedda mood'iyaanne hawantta gatsi oytsiyaa mood'iyaa ubbaa,
laa"u kilahotuwaa, unttunttu bolla de'iyaa handdaanne gaylliyaa matan de'iyaa mood'iyaa, tiriyaa s'eeraa bolla de'iyaa mood'iyaa kilahotuwaana gatsiide akkee.
K'eesii he k'umaa yarshshuwaa Med'inaa Godaw taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshiyaa sa'aa bolla wotsiide s'uuggo.
« ‹Aa yarshshuu deeshshaa gidooppe, I hewaa Med'inaa Godaa sintsan shiishsho.
Yaatiide Aa huup'iyaan bare kushiyaa wotsiide, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa sintsan shukko. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Aaroona attuma naanay suutsaa oyk'k'iide, yarshshiyaa sa'aa yuushshuwaan ubbaan gussiino.
I he yarshshiyaawaappe akkiide, taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide Med'inaa Godaw shiishsho; hewekka k'antsaa ashuwaa mayyeedda handdaa ubbaanne he handdaa gatsi oytsiyaa hara handdaa,
laa"u kilahotuwaa, unttunttu bolla de'iyaa handdaanne gaylliyaa matan de'iyaa mood'iyaanne tiriyaa s'eeraa bolla de'iyaa mood'iyaa kilahotuwaana gatsiide akkee.
K'eesii he k'umaa taman s'uuggiyaa, sawuwaa toshukku giyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide yarshshiyaa sa'aa bolla s'uuggo. Handdaa ubbay Med'inaa Godaassa.
« ‹Handdaanne suutsaa hintte de'iyaa sa'aan hak'aninne mooppite. Hawe hinttenttoonne hintte yeletaw med'inaw naagettiyaa wogaa› yaagaade oda» yaageedda.
